name: Spreading glow
before_label: The lantern light alone, through the jade
change: The lantern light stays at the top. A diffuse glow inside the jade stretches toward the pointer: its soft parts reach different distances at different speeds, so it lengthens as you move and gathers back into a soft cloud when you leave.
good: Most like light moving inside the stone: it stretches toward the pointer and gathers back, and the lantern light never moves.
watch: On small panels it has little room to stretch, so there it behaves like the drifting glow.

name: Drifting glow
before_label: The lantern light alone, through the jade
change: The lantern light stays at the top. A diffuse, uneven glow inside the jade drifts a third of the way toward the pointer as one, starting and settling slowly.
good: The simplest: one soft, uneven cloud of light that drifts and settles slowly.
watch: It moves as one piece, so it can still feel like a light pulled toward the pointer, only slower and softer.

name: Deep glow
before_label: The lantern light alone, through the jade
change: The lantern light stays at the top. A broad, faint glow deep in the jade shifts only a fifth of the way toward the pointer, slowly.
good: The calmest: a broad glow that barely shifts, like light far inside the slab.
watch: Easy to miss; most of what it adds is a slightly brighter middle.
